name: AgentMesh
description: Discovery hub and orchestrator for the open agentic web. Scans sites, scores their manifests, maps their tools and routes tasks across them.

tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Find and return the .network.json manifest of any public website.

tools.name: validate_manifest
tools.description: Fetch a site's manifest and score its quality from 0 to 100 with a list of issues.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents in the public AgentMesh registry.
